newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-QPR SET TO SELL STRIKER SINCLAIR.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-QPR SET TO SELL STRIKER SINCLAIR.

text.p: Highly-rated striker Trevor Sinclair seems set to finally leave Queens Park Rangers after club owner Chris Wright said his transfer request would be discussed at the next board meeting.
The former England Under-21 player officially asked for a move last week and Wright said it would be considered in two weeks time.

Tottenham, Sheffield Wednesday, Blackburn and Leeds have all shown an interest in him and Wright added: "Although we don't want to lose good players, we also only want players who are committed to Queens Park Rangers.
